translation: An intensified form of salience in which something stands out with exceptional vividness, presence, and attention-grabbing force. In positive forms it can accompany flow or awakening; in distorted forms it can be exploited by compulsive or addictive attention loops.
origin_background: The Tim Ferriss interview transcript has Vervaeke explicitly say that in flow 'everything is super salient' and 'super present.' Related higher-states material in Awakening from the Meaning Crisis Episode 11 describes a dramatic increase in clarity, vividness, brightness, and sense-making, which fits the same salience intensification family.
vervaeke_usage: Vervaeke uses the idea to point at how relevance realization can become especially vivid and powerful: more of the world lights up as meaningful, actionable, and real. It helps explain why flow, insight, and transformed states can feel hyper-real rather than merely intense.
provenance: Awakening from the Meaning Crisis Ep. 11
source_note_title: Tim Ferriss interview transcript / Episode 11: Higher States of Consciousness, Part 1
notes: Added because the exact phrase 'super salient' appears in Vervaeke’s discussion of flow and higher states.
